project.title: COVID-19 Isolation Dorm Mapping
project.description: We have collected 16S, metabolomic, and RT-qPCR data to search for correlations between SARS-CoV-2 and other molecular signatures from the dorm rooms of COVID-19 infected individuals.
project.center_name: University of California San Diego Microbiome Initiative
